subject: CAIQ: inference runtime control coverage, evidence gate and delivery plan
messages:
From: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@greenbridge.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ follow-up: inference-specific control coverage and artifacts

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Our security team has a couple of follow-ups specific to the CAIQ that we want to close for procurement: they want a concise mapping of CAIQ controls that are relevant to model serving / inference (tenant isolation, KV cache management, telemetry & replayability, model routing/fallback, and cryptographic key handling) and a small set of supporting artifacts we can review.

Specifically, can you provide:
- A short control crosswalk that lists CSA control IDs + Redwood assertion + where evidence lives (links preferred).
- A runtime log sample (redacted is fine) that shows a request trace including model variant fallback and the KV cache hit/miss markers.
- A high-level note about how private deployments (VPC/onprem) change the evidence we provide vs hosted API.

We'd like to get this into the CAIQ by EOW so procurement can finalize terms. Attaching the CAIQ template they asked us to annotate.

Thanks,
Tom

--
Tom Ellis
Head of Vendor Security, GreenBridge Health
security@greenbridge.com
From: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@greenbridge.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, david.kim@redwood.com <david_kim@redwood.com>, kimberly.park@redwood.com <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up: inference-specific control coverage and artifacts

Tom — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Marissa (evidence owner for CAIQ collections), David (runtime/telemetry SME) and Kimberly (privacy/compliance) to scope deliverables.

High level plan (quick):
1) Marissa will produce a 1-page crosswalk (CSA control -> Redwood assertion -> artifact link) focused only on inference-serving controls you called out.
2) David will extract a 24-hour request trace (redacted) and annotate the events that demonstrate fallback routing and KV cache markers. We'll remove any PII and tenant identifiers.
3) Kimberly will add a short note describing differences for private deployments and how evidence is handed off (KMS/HSM integration notes included).

Can you confirm the acceptable delivery formats: annotated CAIQ PDF + runtime log CSV + short memo? Also, is DocuSign preferred for the signature/attestation portion or a signed email will suffice?

I'll aim to get a draft crosswalk and the log sample uploaded to the shared Drive by Wednesday morning.

Best,
Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Sales Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Tom Ellis <t.ellis@greenbridge.com>
Cc: david.kim@redwood.com <david_kim@redwood.com>, kimberly.park@redwood.com <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: RE: CAIQ follow-up: inference-specific control coverage and artifacts

Hi all — attaching the deliverables we've prepared (attachments: caiq-mapping-inference-v1.3.pdf, runtime-log-sample-20260614.csv). Notes / highlights below.

Quick highlights from the crosswalk (summary):
- CCM ID CC-07 (Tenant Isolation): Assertion — multi-tenant isolation enforced by per-tenant scheduling + namespace-delimited KV caches. Evidence — orchestration config snippet + runtime log demonstrating namespace validation (see runtime-log-sample column "tenant_ns" and "ns_validation_pass").
- CCM ID CC-10 (Cryptographic Controls): Assertion — all customer keys for Private deployments can be customer-managed via KMS/HSM; hosted API keys are rotated and stored encrypted. Evidence — KMS rotation policy extract (link in doc).
- CCM ID CM-16 (Monitoring & Logging): Assertion — continuous telemetry with trace-id correlation across routing/fallback events; evidence — 24h log sample with fallback event (event_type=fallback, fallback_target=model-a-q4).
- CCM ID CM-11 (Change Management): Assertion — model rollout is governed by canary + automated rollback; evidence — rollout policy excerpt and sample canary metrics (doc).

About formats: Tom — we included an annotated CAIQ PDF and a redacted CSV log (timestamps, trace_id, event_type, kv_hit, tenant_ns). For signing/attestation, a signed email from an authorized Redwood contact is fine for now; we can produce a DocuSign packet if you need a formal signature later.

Action items we need from GreenBridge:
- Confirm that redaction level in runtime-log-sample is acceptable (we replaced tenant ids with stable hashed labels and removed prompt/response text).
- If you require a DocuSign attestation, indicate the contact and we will route to Legal/Rev for signature.

I've uploaded the artifacts to the shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bC-model-evidence (link in metadata).

Attachments: caiq-mapping-inference-v1.3.pdf (annotated crosswalk), runtime-log-sample-20260614.csv (redacted trace sample)

Thanks,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Principal, Solutions & Compliance, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up: inference-specific control coverage and artifacts

Marissa / Hannah — received, and the artifacts look good at a glance. The runtime sample demonstrates the fallback and kv_hit markers we needed. Two quick asks before we close the CAIQ: please include the orchestration config excerpt as a single-page snippet (we saw references but need the exact path/file) and add one sentence in the CAIQ PDF clarifying how replay logs are retained and access-controlled for audit (retention window, roles that can access logs).

If you can get those two items into the folder by EOD Monday, procurement will proceed with the SOW signoff. Signed email attestation will be fine for now.

Best,
Tom

--
